profile.name: Rafely Chandra Rizkilillah
profile.subtitle: Architecting high-throughput payment infrastructure, single API orchestration, and core banking migrations under scale.
retroNarrative: In an era of rapid digital transactions, Rafely operates at the precise intersection of concurrent Go code, high-throughput payment pipelines, and secure ledger telemetry. Fabricating robust digital apparatuses that handle millions of micro-finance data transmissions with absolute mathematical reliability.

With over five years of documented practice in fintech payment workshops, Rafely has mastered the alignment of core financial flows. His digital workbench delivers resilient full-stack elements, safe server-side gateway relays (KrakenD, Kong), and databases engineered with high-fidelity performance.

Whether launching QRIS integration nodes, tuning database query metrics, or structuring secure e-wallet top-ups, he approaches code with rigorous standards corresponding to the classic Swiss grid layouts of early computational systems.

description: Architected and owned Single API, the central payment orchestration layer for cash-in, cash-out, QRIS, remittance, and e-wallet flows, introducing adapter-based architecture and state transition validations.
Led end-to-end QRIS Acquiring and Issuing integration with Artajasa/ASPI, delivering static/dynamic QR APIs, payment credits, refund options, Luhn validation, and retry logic.
Integrated multi-provider remittance (bank transfer money-out) with BRI, Digiasia, and FLIP with callback orchestration and scheduled status checks.
Prevented critical financial incidents by resolving Sev-0 and Sev-2 events (wallet double-hit, double responses to BRI VA, and idempotency failures).

experiences.role: Software Developer Engineer Sr. Analyst (Wealth Team)
description: Led a 4-engineer team delivering e-wallet top-up, cash-out, and loan order services for hundreds of thousands of Amartha investors.
Integrated Xendit and Midtrans for e-wallet funding flows, enabling fast onboarding of new wallet providers with minimal platform changes.
Implemented Kafka-driven event sourcing for asynchronous loan order processing, decoupling upstream services and reducing timeout failures.
Managed priority loan partial repayment flows, ensuring correct installment allocation and accurate investor ledger updates.
Rebuilt core money-flow services (disbursement, failed disbursement, repayment, partial repayment) from scratch, improving reliability across all loan types.
Led core banking migration to vendor FDS, coordinating cross-functional alignment and ensuring zero-downtime cutover for all company transactions.
Redesigned the loan insurance claim system to auto-trigger claims for PAR loans with 4+ consecutive defaults, protecting investor capital automatically.
Maintained the MIS Dashboard covering all loans, investors, and installment transactions, supporting data-driven decisions for risk and operations teams.
Designed and implemented RESTful CRUD APIs for Tunaiku's customer-facing FAQ and Help Center platform using Go and PostgreSQL.
Collaborated with the Customer Service Improvement team to streamline information flows and reduce customer support ticket volume.

achievements: Graduand with a deep theoretical and practical focus on computing systems, data engineering, and software structures.
Participated in comprehensive programming and database lab development work.

Google AI Competition: #JuaraVibeCoding, 2026 — Developed and deployed two AI-powered web applications on Google Cloud Run using Gemini AI Studio: 'Make It 24' (math puzzle game) and 'Indonesian E-Voting Simulation'.
